seed_allocation: Check all intervening plans and claims; reserve disjoint unused ranges in a separately frozen executable plan before rendering.
score: One score per scene: maximum target displacement across all46 keyboard targets and all4 condition variants.
quantile_rule: Sort1000 scene scores; use one-based rank ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))=991. If rank>n use infinity and abstain.
uncertainty: Single global board-frame radius in millimetres; not image-specific confidence or physical calibration.
research_admission: Global radius <=3mm permits research-only acceptance; otherwise abstain on all images. No gate adjustment after outcomes.
confirmation_rule: Observed scene coverage >=0.99 and research accepted fraction >0; report exact scene counts, image counts, maximum errors, and binomial uncertainty. No runtime qualification follows.
forbidden_inputs: consumed confirmation errors for quantile fitting
nominal fixed board rectangles as runtime target placement
